name: non-building-read-from-the-archived-logs
why: THE BUILD GATE, on the FALLBACK path. Arm B's declared-done state does not build on any blind run, and the runs carry no `finalBuild` field — the live dry epoch's shape — so the build fact has to come from the archived logs alone. `run-pair.sh` runs the held-out suite only inside the build's success branch, so a missing `.ho_final.txt` IS the non-building signature. An analyzer that read that as "built, nothing failed" would publish zero runs in the "did not build at declared-done" category and lose the one number that tells an adjudicator why arm B's escape rate is zero: the compiler refused the laundering. The escape rate is 0 either way, which is exactly why this needs its own fixture.
